General & Multi-Discipline · Revit Add-in

Type Parameter Transfer

Standardize data across Revit family types.

Copy, move, assign, or clear Revit type parameter values in bulk. Find compatible target parameters and manage changes across the selected types.

Request Demo on WhatsApp Compare Workflows
Key features

Change the type definition once

A type parameter belongs to the family type and can affect many placed elements. Review the selected types before applying a change across the model.

  • 01

    Browse all categories → select types → view available type parameters

  • 02

    Transfer values between type parameters (Move or Copy) with auto storage-type filtering

  • 03

    Assign custom values directly to any type parameter across the project

  • 04

    Clear type parameter values from selected types in bulk

  • 05

    Supports all parameter storage types

    String, Integer, Double, Element ID

  • 06

    Essential for standardizing type data, quantity takeoff preparation, and BIM data exports

Workflow comparison

Manual Revit vs. Type Parameter Transfer

TaskManual Revit workflowWith Type Parameter Transfer
Find the types in scopeManual Revit workflowOpen or schedule the relevant family types and identify the parameters.With Type Parameter TransferBrowse by category, select types, and view available type parameters.
Copy or move a parameterManual Revit workflowTransfer values type by type or prepare a suitable schedule.With Type Parameter TransferChoose a compatible target and transfer the values across the selection.
Standardize valuesManual Revit workflowOpen each type or edit through the schedule and verify the result.With Type Parameter TransferSet or clear the chosen value in bulk and check representative types.
